discription: A lead synth sound using a pulse wave with controllable pulse width and an ADSR envelope for a crisp attack and decay.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.7, 0.5, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig = LFPulse.ar(freq, 0, pulseWidth) * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
